title: WHOSOEVER WILL
author: Philip p.Bilss
stanzas: "Whosoever heareth," shout, shout the sound! Send the blessed tidings all the world around: spread the joyful news wherever man is found, "Whosoever will may come."
"Whosoever cometh need not delay, Now the door is open, enter while you may; Jesus is the true, the only Living Way: "Whosoever will may come."
"Whosoever will" the promise is secure; "Whosoever will," forever just endure; "Whosoever will!" 'tis life forever more; "Whosoever will may come."
chorus: Send the proclamation over vale and hill;
